limitations: This is a post-result alternative measurement rule, not a replacement for the frozen strict primary outcome.
Recovering a legal action does not repair an executable decision with invalid duration/effects or validate its explanation.
Malformed JSON and illegal action labels remain rejected; only optional-field checks differ.
Both estimates retain completed-call denominators. Validity rates change their meaning under the two rules.
Intervals are pointwise Wilson/Newcombe summaries, not a new confirmatory multiple-comparison family.
Duration values are recorded as generated; no seconds-to-ticks conversion or inferred cause is imposed.

plan.action_only_rule: Parsed object + legal action + EOS; ignore optional duration_ticks and contextual_effects checks. This is recoverable action-choice sensitivity, not a repaired executable decision or a replacement primary outcome.

contrasts.controls: All 16 frozen low-minus-high rest/energy or eat/satiety contrasts for both rules.
contrasts.peer: All 12 frozen high-minus-low study contrasts for both measurement rules, counts per completed denominator; compare whether study counts or effects change.
contrasts.uncertainty: Retain pointwise Wilson/Newcombe 95% as descriptive measurement sensitivity. No p-values, no new confirmatory family, no classifier selection based on favorable outcome.

plan.disclosure: Formal outcomes and failure categories have already been inspected, including legal exercise actions with duration_ticks=300 rejected by the strict parser. This is not preregistration, does not replace the registered primary outcome, and makes no new model calls.
plan.extraction: Use original first opening brace through last closing brace, json.loads; require one parsed dict. Do not repair malformed JSON or substitute/salvage illegal actions. Action normalization is the registered strip().lower() only.
plan.figure: NEW compact 3-run x 4-profile peer-dose plot using all three levels, strict and action-only curves/pointwise Wilson intervals; annotate differences explicitly. No old/pilot data.
plan.outcomes: Per run/profile/arm/level: strict/action-only validity and all seven action counts; raw parsing, action, optional schema, termination reasons; duration type/value and optional-context failure summaries.
plan.outputs: NEW measurement_audit/ JSON/CSV plus optional PDF/PNG figure and hash receipt. Do not edit frozen/raw/original analysis/paper files.
plan.raw_source: All formal final.jsonl raw_content strings and generated_token_ids/EOS metadata; cached parsed/action/parse_status fields are not used to classify audit outcomes. Existing hashes and planned-call identities are validated.
plan.strict_rule: Parsed object + legal action + EOS; optional duration_ticks, if supplied, must have exact int type and lie in [1,6]; optional contextual_effects, if supplied, must be an object. Mirrors registered structural validity independently.
plan.termination: Require generated token sequence to terminate at EOS, with logged stop/eos and no truncation. Record any token/log termination mismatch.
plan.validation: Independent parser fixtures for malformed JSON, illegal action, duration=300, bool/float duration, nonobject effects, and non-EOS; verify strict agrees with archived structural-validity decisions and show all disagreements rather than overwrite them.
